label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly into URL construction on line 24 ('http://' + host). Although isNonPublicAddress() validates the resolved IP, it only checks specific address types and doesn't block all SSRF vectors (e.g., IPv6, cloud metadata endpoints, or DNS rebinding during the sleep window). The resolved sink value at line 24 is attacker-controlled host string used in URL.openConnection().connect(), enabling potential SSRF to internal resources.

evidence.note: User input param -> host -> URL construction with openConnection().connect()
